description: This file contains configuration classes for integrating AWS SQS streaming with Orleans. It defines configurator classes to set up SQS stream options, cache parameters, and partitioning strategies within Orleans silo and client contexts.

classes.name: SiloSqsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for SQS streaming on Orleans silo, allowing configuration of SQS options, cache, and partitioning.

classes.name: ClusterClientSqsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for SQS streaming on Orleans cluster client, enabling setup of SQS options and partitioning.

methods.name: ConfigureSqs
methods.description: Configures the SQS options for the stream.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Configures the cache size for the SQS stream.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures the number of partitions (queues) for the SQS stream.
